title: Northbeam TechWorks Benefit Year Note: The Window Redemptions Are Counted Over
content:
The window over which the redemptions of the membership year are counted, when a relief is worked out on a Northbeam TechWorks Installation and Repair job, is fixed from the customer's Northbeam Circle Membership.

## The three ways the window is counted

**Where the membership's current term began within the last twelve months and the membership stands active**, the redemptions of the membership year are counted over the months since that term began, and never fewer than one month.

**Where the tier now recorded on the membership took effect within the last twelve months**, the redemptions are counted over the months since that tier took effect, and never fewer than one month.

**Where neither of those situations holds**, the redemptions are counted over the twelve months ending on the day the relief is granted.

Where no Circle membership stands active on the profile, the windows above are counted as one month.

## The order in which the three are read

| The membership's current term began within the last 12 months, and the membership stands active | The tier now recorded took effect within the last 12 months | The window |
| --- | --- | --- |
| yes | either | the months since that term began, at least 1 |
| no | yes | the months since that tier took effect, at least 1 |
| no | no | 12 months ending on the day the relief is granted |

Both of the first two windows carry a floor of one month, so a term or a tier that began in the current month still gives a window of one month rather than nothing.

## Illustrations on hypothetical memberships

*The ages below are chosen for the illustration and are not those of any membership on file.*

**A term three years old and a tier three years old.** Neither situation holds, and the window is the 12 months ending on the day the relief is granted.

**A term two years old, a tier changed nine months ago.** The first situation fails on the age of the term. The tier took effect within the last twelve months, so the window is 9 months.

**A term seven months old, membership active.** The first situation governs and the window is 7 months. Redemptions booked ten months back fall outside it.

**A term begun this month.** The months since it began count as nothing, but the floor of one month applies, so the window is 1 month.
